evals.prompt: Use the local OMA Fetcher to retrieve ISO's robots.txt and explain which fallback strategy succeeded.
evals.expected_output: A curl + jq command that checks code, prints robots content only on success, and reports meta.attempts.

evals.prompt: List the first 20 page URLs from https://www.iso.org/sitemap/standard.xml through the service.
evals.expected_output: A sitemap request whose jq expression decodes the JSON string in data with fromjson before slicing.

evals.prompt: The fetch API printed null while reading a protected page. Diagnose it without treating null as content.
